def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_worth = 1_200_000
    tax_brackets = [
        (500_000, 0.00),
        (1_000_000, 0.02),
        (1_200_000, 0.04),
    ]
    residency_factor = 0.9

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_tax = 0
    previous_threshold = 0

    for threshold, rate in tax_brackets:
        if net_worth > threshold:
            total_tax += (threshold - previous_threshold) * rate
            previous_threshold = threshold
        else:
            total_tax += (net_worth - previous_threshold) * rate
            break

    adjusted_tax = total_tax * residency_factor

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(adjusted_tax)
